mandate_initiation_request.description: The MandateInitiationRequest message is sent by the initiator of the request to his agent. The initiator can either be the debtor or the creditor. The MandateInitiationRequest message is forwarded by the agent of the initiator to the agent of the counterparty. The MandateInitiationRequest message is used to setup the instruction that allows the debtor agent to accept instructions from the creditor, through the creditor agent, to debit the account of the debtor.
